steps.claim: The Oklahoma City bombing

test.source: “Did Fertility Go Up after the Oklahoma City Bombing? An Analysis of Births in Metropolitan Counties in Oklahoma, 1990–1999,” Demography, 2005

steps.note: Dated to the month, as the paper gives it.

steps.claim: More babies were born in Oklahoma County

test.design: difference in differences
test.source: “Did Fertility Go Up after the Oklahoma City Bombing? An Analysis of Births in Metropolitan Counties in Oklahoma, 1990–1999,” Demography, 2005
test.effect: a significant rise in births in Oklahoma County after the bombing

steps.note: From the paper: “Oklahoma County showed an interpretable, consistent, and significant increase in births.” The paper counts monthly births in Oklahoma's metro counties from 1990 to 1999 and compares Oklahoma County with the others.

steps.claim: Sesame Street begins airing

test.source: “Early Childhood Education by Television: Lessons from Sesame Street,” American Economic Journal: Applied Economics, 2019

steps.note: Dated to the year, as the paper gives it.

steps.claim: Kids in places that could get the show were more often at the right grade for their age

test.design: natural experiment on TV reception
test.source: “Early Childhood Education by Television: Lessons from Sesame Street,” American Economic Journal: Applied Economics, 2019
test.effect: better school performance, most for boys and for kids in poorer areas

steps.note: From the paper: “The results indicate that Sesame Street improved school performance, particularly for boys.” Reception depended on the kind of signal and the distance to a tower. The paper reads grade for age in the 1980 census. Its estimates for adult schooling and jobs are too imprecise to call.

steps.claim: Television arrives in US cities, some years before others

test.source: “Was Television Responsible for a New Generation of Smokers?” Journal of Consumer Research, 2019

steps.note: The rollout began in 1946. Dated here to that year.

steps.claim: More Americans took up smoking

test.design: difference in differences
test.source: “Was Television Responsible for a New Generation of Smokers?” Journal of Consumer Research, 2019
test.effect: the share of smokers rose 5 to 15 percentage points, about 11 million more smokers from 1946 to 1970

steps.note: From the paper: “Our preferred estimates suggest that television increased the share of smokers in the population by 5–15 percentage points.” People aged 16 to 21 were hit hardest, and most of the rise came within a couple of years of TV's arrival.

title: Rede Globo's telenovelas and family size (1965)

steps.claim: Rede Globo's signal, and its telenovelas, reach more Brazilian towns

test.source: “Soap Operas and Fertility: Evidence from Brazil,” American Economic Journal: Applied Economics, 2012

steps.note: The rollout ran from 1965 to 1991. Dated here to its first year.

steps.claim: Women had fewer children where the Globo signal arrived

test.design: staggered signal arrival compared across areas
test.source: “Soap Operas and Fertility: Evidence from Brazil,” American Economic Journal: Applied Economics, 2012
test.effect: significantly lower fertility where Globo's signal arrived, most for poorer women

steps.note: From the paper: “Women living in areas covered by Globo have significantly lower fertility.” The telenovelas showed small families. The paper uses census data from 1970 to 1991.

title: Rede Globo's telenovelas and baby names (1965)

steps.claim: Rede Globo's signal, and its telenovelas, reach more Brazilian towns

test.source: “Soap Operas and Fertility: Evidence from Brazil,” American Economic Journal: Applied Economics, 2012

steps.note: The rollout ran from 1965 to 1991. Dated here to its first year.

steps.claim: Parents named their children after telenovela characters

test.design: staggered signal arrival compared across areas
test.source: “Soap Operas and Fertility: Evidence from Brazil,” American Economic Journal: Applied Economics, 2012
test.effect: children's names followed the characters of the telenovelas

steps.note: The paper uses naming patterns to show the telenovelas themselves shaped choices. The size of the effect is in the paper's body, which we did not check.

steps.claim: A month-long blackout hits Zanzibar

test.source: “Power Outages, Power Externalities, and Baby Booms,” Demography, 2014

steps.note: Dated to the year, as the paper gives it.

steps.claim: More babies were born in villages with electricity

test.design: births compared across villages with and without power
test.source: “Power Outages, Power Externalities, and Baby Booms,” Demography, 2014
test.effect: a significant rise in births 8 to 10 months later in villages with electricity, none in villages without

steps.note: From the paper: “a month-long blackout in 2008 caused a significant increase in the number of births 8 to 10 months later.” The paper says it is unclear whether the boom adds to the population for good.

title: Ramayan on TV and baby names (1987)

steps.claim: Ramayan, a TV serial of the Hindu epic, airs in India

test.source: “Ancient Epics in the Television Age: Religious Identity and the Rise of Hindu Nationalism in India,” NBER working paper, 2025

steps.note: It aired in 1987 and 1988. Dated here to 1987.

steps.claim: Parents gave newborn sons more traditionally Hindu names

test.design: difference in differences on TV signal strength
test.source: “Ancient Epics in the Television Age: Religious Identity and the Rise of Hindu Nationalism in India,” NBER working paper, 2025
test.effect: more traditionally Hindu names for newborn sons where the signal was stronger, and the shift lasted

steps.note: From the paper: “Localities with higher Ramayan exposure saw persistently strengthened Hindu religious identity, measured by the names given to newborns.”

steps.claim: Twende na Wakati, a radio soap opera, begins airing in Tanzania

test.source: “A Staged Model of Communication Effects: Evidence from an Entertainment-Education Radio Soap Opera in Tanzania,” Journal of Health Communication, 2000

steps.note: Its first broadcast year ran from 1993 to 1994. Dated here to 1993.

steps.claim: More couples used family planning

test.design: broadcast area compared with an area that heard it later
test.source: “A Staged Model of Communication Effects: Evidence from an Entertainment-Education Radio Soap Opera in Tanzania,” Journal of Health Communication, 2000
test.effect: family planning use rose from 19% to 28%, and 26% of new clinic clients named the show

steps.note: From the paper: “the radio soap opera promoted progress through the stages for family planning adoption in the treatment area.” The effect showed in three of the four broadcast years, and in the comparison area once the show reached it.

steps.claim: Sideways opens; the film praises Pinot Noir and mocks Merlot

test.source: Date from a second study

steps.note: Dated to the release year by a second study.

steps.claim: Americans bought less Merlot and more Pinot Noir

test.design: tests for breaks in sales trends
test.source: “The Sideways Effect: A Test for Changes in the Demand for Merlot and Pinot Noir Wines,” Journal of Wine Economics, 2009
test.effect: breaks in US sales of both wines after the film, which a 2021 paper calls the 2005 Sideways demand shock

steps.note: The paper tests each wine's sales before and after the film, by price point. We did not check the sizes in its body. The direction, Pinot Noir up and Merlot down, is stated by the 2021 follow-up paper.

steps.claim: A county's team plays in the Super Bowl

test.source: “Success Is Something to Sneeze At: Influenza Mortality in Cities that Participate in the Super Bowl,” American Journal of Health Economics, 2016

steps.note: The study covers Super Bowls from 1974 to 2009. Dated here to the first year of that window.

steps.claim: More flu deaths among people over 65 in the team's home county

test.design: difference in differences
test.source: “Success Is Something to Sneeze At: Influenza Mortality in Cities that Participate in the Super Bowl,” American Journal of Health Economics, 2016
test.effect: 18% more flu deaths among people over 65 in counties with a team in the game, and no change in host cities

steps.note: From the paper: “We estimate having a local team in the Super Bowl caused an 18 percent increase in influenza deaths for the population over age 65.” The effect was largest in years with a harsher flu strain or a game closer to the flu season's peak.

steps.claim: Pokémon Go is released

test.source: Date from a second study

steps.note: Dated to the month by a second study.

steps.claim: Engaged players walked about 1,473 more steps a day

test.design: players against their own past and against nonplayers
test.source: “Influence of Pokémon Go on Physical Activity: Study and Implications,” Journal of Medical Internet Research, 2016
test.effect: 1,473 more steps a day for engaged players over 30 days, more than 25% above their usual level

steps.note: From the paper: “increasing their activity by 1473 steps a day on average, a more than 25% increase compared with their prior activity level.” The study used wearable sensors on 32,000 Microsoft Band users. A study in Yokohama found players stayed more active for 7 months.

steps.claim: Katie Couric has a colonoscopy live on the Today Show

test.source: “The Impact of a Celebrity Promotional Campaign on the Use of Colon Cancer Screening: The Katie Couric Effect,” Archives of Internal Medicine, 2003

steps.note: Dated to the month, as the paper gives it.

steps.claim: More people got colonoscopies

test.design: change point analysis with trend adjustment
test.source: “The Impact of a Celebrity Promotional Campaign on the Use of Colon Cancer Screening: The Katie Couric Effect,” Archives of Internal Medicine, 2003
test.effect: colonoscopies per doctor rose from 15.0 to 18.1 a month, and the higher rate held for 9 months

steps.note: From the paper: “After adjusting for temporal trends, a significantly higher postcampaign colonoscopy rate was sustained for 9 months.” In a health plan of 44,000 members, the rate rose from 1.3 to 1.8 per 1,000 members a month.

steps.claim: Big violent movies open in US theaters

test.source: “Does Movie Violence Increase Violent Crime?” Quarterly Journal of Economics, 2009

steps.note: The study covers blockbusters from 1995 to 2004. Dated here to the first year.

steps.claim: Fewer assaults on nights when more people saw a violent movie

test.design: daily time series of movie audiences
test.source: “Does Movie Violence Increase Violent Crime?” Quarterly Journal of Economics, 2009
test.effect: violent crime fell on nights with big audiences for violent movies, almost 1,000 fewer assaults on an average weekend

steps.note: From the paper: “Our estimates suggest that in the short run, violent movies deter almost 1,000 assaults on an average weekend.” The paper finds no rise in the three weeks after either.

title: Angelina Jolie's op-ed and BRCA tests (2013)

steps.claim: Angelina Jolie writes in the New York Times about her preventive double mastectomy

test.source: “Do Celebrity Endorsements Matter? Observational Study of BRCA Gene Testing and Mastectomy Rates after Angelina Jolie’s New York Times Editorial,” BMJ, 2016

steps.claim: More women got BRCA gene tests

test.design: difference in differences on insurance claims
test.source: “Do Celebrity Endorsements Matter? Observational Study of BRCA Gene Testing and Mastectomy Rates after Angelina Jolie’s New York Times Editorial,” BMJ, 2016
test.effect: the daily BRCA test rate rose 64% in the 15 business days after, against the same days in 2012, about 4,500 extra tests

steps.note: From the paper: “implying a difference-in-difference absolute daily increase of 0.45 tests/100 000 women or a 64% relative increase.” The study covers 9.5 million insured women aged 18 to 64.

steps.claim: Game of Thrones films in Dubrovnik; the series runs from 2011 to 2019

test.source: Date from a second study

steps.note: Dated to the series' first year by a second study.

steps.claim: More tourists came to Dubrovnik

test.design: synthetic control
test.source: “The Effect of Film Industry on Tourism: Game of Thrones and Dubrovnik,” International Journal of Tourism Research, 2017
test.effect: a robust rise in tourist arrivals, spilling over to other counties and the whole country

steps.note: From the paper: “We find a robust and positive effect of filming the TV series in Dubrovnik on the number of tourist arrivals.” A later study of 14 filming locations in Spain, Croatia and Malta finds a lasting rise in arrivals and overnight stays.

steps.claim: Fox News Channel viewing in US towns

test.source: “Conservative News Media and Criminal Justice: Evidence from Exposure to the Fox News Channel,” The Economic Journal, 2023

steps.note: The study covers 2005 to 2017. Dated here to the first year.

steps.claim: Judges handed down longer sentences

test.design: instrumental variable on channel position
test.source: “Conservative News Media and Criminal Justice: Evidence from Exposure to the Fox News Channel,” The Economic Journal, 2023
test.effect: longer prison terms, most for Black defendants and drug crimes, from elected judges only

steps.note: From the paper: “Local exposure to conservative news causes judges to impose harsher criminal sentences.” The data cover almost seven million sentencing decisions.

steps.claim: The ALS Ice Bucket Challenge goes viral

test.source: “Social Media Charity Campaigns and Pro-Social Behaviour: Evidence from the Ice Bucket Challenge,” Journal of Economic Psychology, 2023

steps.note: Dated to the month, as the paper gives it.

steps.claim: More people gave money and volunteered, for less than a year

test.design: UK panel data by exposure
test.source: “Social Media Charity Campaigns and Pro-Social Behaviour: Evidence from the Ice Bucket Challenge,” Journal of Economic Psychology, 2023
test.effect: a higher chance of donating and volunteering, mostly gone within a year

steps.note: From the paper: “having been exposed to the IBC increases the probability of donating money.”

steps.claim: Jade Goody makes her cervical cancer diagnosis public

test.source: “The Impact of Jade Goody’s Diagnosis and Death on the NHS Cervical Screening Programme,” Journal of Medical Screening, 2012

steps.note: She went public in Aug 2008, said in Feb 2009 that she was terminally ill, and died weeks later.

steps.claim: Far more women went for cervical screening

test.design: screening counts against those expected from other periods
test.source: “The Impact of Jade Goody’s Diagnosis and Death on the NHS Cervical Screening Programme,” Journal of Medical Screening, 2012
test.effect: about half a million extra screenings in England, 70% above expected at the March 2009 peak

steps.note: From the paper: “About half a million extra cervical screening attendances occurred in England between mid-2008 and mid-2009.” 370 of the extra attendances had a result of suspected neoplasia. Wales saw more than 33,000 extra tests.

steps.claim: England plays in the 2002, 2006 and 2010 World Cups

test.source: “Can the FIFA World Cup Football (Soccer) Tournament Be Associated with an Increase in Domestic Abuse?” Journal of Research in Crime and Delinquency, 2013

steps.note: Dated to the first of the three tournaments.

steps.claim: More domestic abuse reports on match days, after wins and losses

test.design: match days compared with other days
test.source: “Can the FIFA World Cup Football (Soccer) Tournament Be Associated with an Increase in Domestic Abuse?” Journal of Research in Crime and Delinquency, 2013
test.effect: reports rose 26% when England won or drew and 38% when England lost, in one North West England police force

steps.note: From the paper: “the risk of domestic abuse rose by 26 percent when the English national team won or drew.”

steps.claim: Radio carries Nazi propaganda across Germany

test.source: “Radio and the Rise of the Nazis in Prewar Germany,” Quarterly Journal of Economics, 2015

steps.note: Dated to 1933, the year the paper's period of Nazi rule begins.

steps.claim: More people joined the Nazi party and reported Jews to the authorities

test.design: radio reception compared across places
test.source: “Radio and the Rise of the Nazis in Prewar Germany,” Quarterly Journal of Economics, 2015
test.effect: radio helped the party enroll members and set off denunciations of Jews, most where anti-Semitism was already high

steps.note: From the paper: “radio propaganda incited anti-Semitic acts and denunciations of Jews to authorities by ordinary citizens.” Where anti-Semitism had been low, the broadcasts had the opposite effect.

steps.claim: Kylie Minogue announces she has breast cancer

test.source: “Use of Breast Cancer Screening and Treatment Services by Australian Women Aged 25–44 Years following Kylie Minogue’s Breast Cancer Diagnosis,” International Journal of Epidemiology, 2008

steps.note: Dated to the month, as the paper gives it.

steps.claim: Young women got more breast scans, and no more cancers were found

test.design: quarters before and after, with a forecast for the UK
test.source: “Use of Breast Cancer Screening and Treatment Services by Australian Women Aged 25–44 Years following Kylie Minogue’s Breast Cancer Diagnosis,” International Journal of Epidemiology, 2008
test.effect: 20% higher odds of breast imaging for Australian women aged 25 to 44, with no change in cancer surgeries

steps.note: From the paper: “The odds of women aged 25-44 years undergoing imaging procedures increased by 20% in the first and second quarters after the Minogue publicity.” A UK clinic saw more referrals and no rise in cancers found.

steps.claim: Rede Globo's signal, and its telenovelas, reach more Brazilian towns

test.source: “Television and Divorce: Evidence from Brazilian Novelas,” 2009

steps.note: This paper covers the rollout from 1970 to 1991. Dated here to its first year.

steps.claim: More women were separated or divorced after the signal arrived

test.design: staggered signal arrival compared across areas
test.source: “Television and Divorce: Evidence from Brazilian Novelas,” 2009
test.effect: a significant rise in the share of women separated or divorced, strongest in smaller areas

steps.note: From the paper: “the share of women who are separated or divorced increases significantly after the Globo signal becomes available.” The paper uses the censuses of 1970, 1980 and 1991.

steps.claim: Angelina Jolie writes in the New York Times about her preventive double mastectomy

test.source: “Do Celebrity Endorsements Matter? Observational Study of BRCA Gene Testing and Mastectomy Rates after Angelina Jolie’s New York Times Editorial,” BMJ, 2016

steps.claim: More women without cancer chose a preventive double mastectomy

test.design: interrupted time series on insurance claims
test.source: “Risk-Reducing Mastectomy Rates in the US: A Closer Examination of the Angelina Jolie Effect,” Breast Cancer Research and Treatment, 2018
test.effect: a significant rise in preventive mastectomies after the op-ed, sustained in later years

steps.note: From the paper: “significant increases in genetic testing and mastectomy rates were observed and sustained in subsequent years.” The claims run from 1997 to 2016. New York State and New South Wales saw rises too.

steps.claim: Brazil plays at the 2014, 2018 and 2022 World Cups

test.source: “Watching the Game, Skipping the Hospital: World Cup Matches and Cardiovascular Hospitalizations,” Cardiology Research, 2026

steps.note: Dated to the first of the three tournaments, which Brazil hosted.

steps.claim: Fewer heart attack and heart failure admissions on match days

test.design: match days against other days
test.source: “Watching the Game, Skipping the Hospital: World Cup Matches and Cardiovascular Hospitalizations,” Cardiology Research, 2026
test.effect: 7.0% fewer heart attack admissions and 11.1% fewer heart failure admissions on Brazil's match days

steps.note: From the paper: “On Brazil match days, AMI admissions were 7.0% lower than non-match days.” AMI means a heart attack.

steps.claim: Charlie Sheen says on national TV that he is HIV positive

test.source: Date from a second study

steps.note: The day comes from a second study. This study gives the week.

steps.claim: Sales of in-home HIV test kits nearly doubled

test.design: weekly sales against expected sales
test.source: “The Charlie Sheen Effect on Rapid In-Home Human Immunodeficiency Virus Test Sales,” Prevention Science, 2017
test.effect: sales rose 95% the week of the disclosure and stayed high for 4 more weeks, 8,225 more kits than expected

steps.note: From the paper: “In total, there were 8225 more sales than expected around Sheen's disclosure, surpassing World AIDS Day by a factor of about 7.”

steps.claim: Sideways opens; the film praises Pinot Noir and mocks Merlot

test.source: “A ‘Sideways’ Supply Response in California Winegrapes,” Journal of Wine Economics, 2021

steps.note: Dated to the release year, as the paper gives it.

steps.claim: California growers shifted grapes toward Pinot Noir

test.design: modified difference in differences
test.source: “A ‘Sideways’ Supply Response in California Winegrapes,” Journal of Wine Economics, 2021
test.effect: Pinot Noir supply rose more than Merlot fell, mostly in lower value Central Valley vineyards

steps.note: From the paper: “The positive supply response for Pinot Noir is stronger than the negative response for Merlot and concentrated in lower value Central Valley vineyards.” The paper uses USDA data from 1999 to 2012.

title: Ramayan on TV and communal violence (1987)

steps.claim: Ramayan, a TV serial of the Hindu epic, airs in India

test.source: “Ancient Epics in the Television Age: Religious Identity and the Rise of Hindu Nationalism in India,” NBER working paper, 2025

steps.note: It aired in 1987 and 1988. Dated here to 1987.

steps.claim: More Hindu-Muslim communal violence through 1992

test.design: difference in differences on TV signal strength
test.source: “Ancient Epics in the Television Age: Religious Identity and the Rise of Hindu Nationalism in India,” NBER working paper, 2025
test.effect: more Hindu-Muslim communal violence through 1992 where the signal was stronger

steps.note: From the paper: “increases in Hindu-Muslim communal violence during the Hindu-nationalist mobilization of the early 1990s.”

steps.claim: Movies air on broadcast and cable TV

test.source: “Competing with Free: The Impact of Movie Broadcasts on DVD Sales and Internet Piracy,” MIS Quarterly, 2009

steps.note: The study covers eight months in 2005 and 2006. Dated here to 2005.

steps.claim: DVD sales of a movie rose after it aired

test.design: each broadcast as an outside shock to demand
test.source: “Competing with Free: The Impact of Movie Broadcasts on DVD Sales and Internet Piracy,” MIS Quarterly, 2009
test.effect: Amazon DVD sales rose after a movie aired on over-the-air TV, and pirated copies did not cut into the gain

steps.note: From the paper: “the post-broadcast increase in DVD sales suggests that giving away content in one channel can stimulate sales in a paid channel.”

steps.claim: A state's big college football team loses a game it was expected to win

test.source: “Emotional Judges and Unlucky Juveniles,” American Economic Journal: Applied Economics, 2018

steps.note: The study covers 1996 to 2012. Dated here to the first year.

steps.claim: Juvenile court judges gave longer sentences the week after

test.design: upset losses measured against betting odds
test.source: “Emotional Judges and Unlucky Juveniles,” American Economic Journal: Applied Economics, 2018
test.effect: longer sentences in the week after an upset loss, borne mostly by Black defendants

steps.note: From the paper: “We find that unexpected losses increase sentence lengths assigned by judges during the week following the game.” Wins and close games made no difference.

steps.claim: Magic Johnson announces he has HIV

test.source: Date from two other studies

steps.note: The day comes from two other studies.

steps.claim: More people sought anonymous HIV counseling and testing

test.design: interrupted time series on weekly visits
test.source: “Harnessing the Heightened Public Awareness of Celebrity HIV Disclosures: ‘Magic’ and ‘Cookie’ Johnson and HIV Testing,” AIDS Education and Prevention, 1995
test.effect: a large, immediate rise across sex, race and age at New York State's 61 anonymous test sites, still above earlier levels 7 months later

steps.note: From the paper: “Seven months later, demand had not returned to pre-disclosure levels.”

steps.claim: Chadwick Boseman dies of colon cancer

test.source: Date from a second study

steps.claim: Donations to the Colon Cancer Foundation jumped

test.design: the foundation's own before and after figures
test.source: “Public Interest and Behavior Change in the United States Regarding Colorectal Cancer Following the Death of Chadwick Boseman,” JMIR Infodemiology, 2021
test.effect: the Colon Cancer Foundation reported a 331% rise in donations, and searches ran 3,590% above forecast

steps.note: From the paper: “The Colon Cancer Foundation reported a 331% increase in donations.”

steps.claim: Blackfish, a documentary about orcas at SeaWorld, is released

test.source: “Nature Documentaries as Catalysts for Change: Mapping Out the ‘Blackfish Effect’,” People and Nature, 2021

steps.note: Dated to the year, as the paper gives it.

steps.claim: SeaWorld's attendance and market value fell, and it ended its orca breeding

test.design: stock data and interviews with 26 key informants
test.source: “Nature Documentaries as Catalysts for Change: Mapping Out the ‘Blackfish Effect’,” People and Nature, 2021
test.effect: attendance and market value fell and the orca breeding program ended

steps.note: From the paper: “Following its release, SeaWorld suffered financial difficulties and the company underwent structural changes, including a cessation of its orca breeding programme.”

steps.claim: MTV's 16 and Pregnant first airs

test.source: Date from a second study

steps.note: Dated to the year by a second study.

steps.claim: The show cut teen births by 4.3%

test.design: difference in differences reanalysis
test.source: “A Cautionary Tale of Evaluating Identifying Assumptions: Did Reality TV Really Cause a Decline in Teenage Childbearing?” Journal of Business & Economic Statistics, 2018
test.finding: With controls for earlier trends in birth rates the effect disappears, and placebo tests find an effect long before the show aired

also.source: “Media Influences on Social Outcomes: The Impact of MTV’s 16 and Pregnant on Teen Childbearing,” American Economic Review, 2015

steps.note: A 2015 study estimated the drop: “The results imply that this show led to a 4.3 percent reduction in teen births.” A 2018 reanalysis: “we find evidence of an ‘effect’ long before 16 and Pregnant started broadcasting.”

steps.claim: England loses to Argentina on penalties at the World Cup

test.source: “Admissions for Myocardial Infarction and World Cup Football: Database Survey,” BMJ, 2002

steps.claim: Heart attack admissions in England rose 25% over three days

test.design: admissions time series and a review
test.source: “It Is Just a Game: Lack of Association between Watching Football Matches and the Risk of Acute Cardiovascular Events,” International Journal of Epidemiology, 2010
test.finding: A study of Italy's matches found no rise in heart attack admissions (relative risk 1.01), and most studies it reviewed put the risk between 0.7 and 1.3

also.source: “Admissions for Myocardial Infarction and World Cup Football: Database Survey,” BMJ, 2002

steps.note: The 1998 study counted 55 extra admissions: “Risk of admission for acute myocardial infarction increased by 25%.” The 2010 study concluded: “The cardiovascular effects of watching football matches are likely to be, if anything, very small.”

steps.claim: Finding Dory, a Pixar film starring a blue tang, is released

test.source: “Did the Movie Finding Dory Increase Demand for Blue Tang Fish?” Ambio, 2020

steps.note: Dated to the year.

steps.claim: People rushed to buy blue tang fish

test.design: Bayesian counterfactual time series
test.source: “Did the Movie Finding Dory Increase Demand for Blue Tang Fish?” Ambio, 2020
test.finding: Online searches rose for 2 to 3 weeks, but US imports of blue tang and visits to aquariums did not rise against the counterfactual

steps.note: From the paper: “we find no substantial evidence for an increase in imports of blue tang fish into the US.”

steps.claim: The Harry Potter books and films appear, 1997 to 2011

test.source: “Investigating the Impact of Media on Demand for Wildlife: A Case Study of Harry Potter and the UK Trade in Owls,” PLOS ONE, 2017

steps.note: Dated to 1997, the first year of the series.

steps.claim: A UK craze for pet owls, then mass abandonment

test.design: time series of owl ownership against box office, book sales and press
test.source: “Investigating the Impact of Media on Demand for Wildlife: A Case Study of Harry Potter and the UK Trade in Owls,” PLOS ONE, 2017
test.finding: Three measures of legal owl ownership in the UK show no rise tied to the books or films, even with time lags, and sanctuaries reported no wave of abandoned owls

steps.note: From the paper: “Counter to common assertions, we find no evidence that the ‘Harry Potter’ phenomenon increased the legal trade in owls within the UK.”

steps.claim: Blue Planet II airs on the BBC

test.source: “Evaluating the Impact of the Documentary Series Blue Planet II on Viewers’ Plastic Consumption Behaviors,” Conservation Science and Practice, 2020

steps.note: Dated to the year.

steps.claim: Viewers cut their use of plastic

test.design: randomized controlled trials
test.source: “Evaluating the Impact of the Documentary Series Blue Planet II on Viewers’ Plastic Consumption Behaviors,” Conservation Science and Practice, 2020
test.finding: In randomized trials, viewers learned more about ocean plastic, and their plastic buying did not change

steps.note: From the paper: “Although environmental knowledge was found to be positively influenced by Blue Planet II, this did not translate into a behavioral change among participants.”

steps.claim: London hosts the 2012 Olympic Games

test.source: “An Evidence-Based Assessment of the Impact of the Olympic Games on Population Levels of Physical Activity,” The Lancet, 2021

steps.note: The study covers London 2012 and earlier host cities. Dated here to 2012.

steps.claim: More people in the host country exercise and play sport

test.design: synthesis of host-area surveys
test.source: “An Evidence-Based Assessment of the Impact of the Olympic Games on Population Levels of Physical Activity,” The Lancet, 2021
test.finding: Surveys in host areas show no change in physical activity or sport, except after Beijing 2008 and Nagano 1998, and a 2015 review found no built-in demonstration effect

steps.note: From the paper: “By themselves, the Olympic Games have not improved population-wide physical activity but might be an important missed public health opportunity.”

steps.claim: Angelina Jolie writes in the New York Times about her preventive double mastectomy

test.source: “Do Celebrity Endorsements Matter? Observational Study of BRCA Gene Testing and Mastectomy Rates after Angelina Jolie’s New York Times Editorial,” BMJ, 2016

steps.claim: More women got routine screening mammograms

test.design: interrupted time series
test.source: “Evaluation of the ‘Angelina Jolie Effect’ on Screening Mammography Utilization in an Academic Center,” Journal of the American College of Radiology, 2017
test.finding: At one large breast imaging center, 48,110 screening mammograms over four years showed no jump or speedup after the op-ed

steps.note: From the paper: “we found no support for the hypothesis that this celebrity news drove increased screening.” This test covers routine screening at one center. BRCA gene tests did rise.

steps.claim: Taylor Swift attends Kansas City Chiefs games

test.source: “The Folklore of the ‘Swift’ Effect: Lessons for Medical Research and Clinical Practice,” PLOS ONE, 2025

steps.note: Dated to the 2023 season.

steps.claim: Travis Kelce played better with Swift in the stands

test.design: covariate matching
test.source: “The Folklore of the ‘Swift’ Effect: Lessons for Medical Research and Clinical Practice,” PLOS ONE, 2025
test.finding: Kelce's yardage in the 13 games Swift attended did not differ from matched games before her, and the Chiefs did not win more often

steps.note: From the paper: “Kelce's yardage did not significantly differ when Taylor Swift was in attendance.”
